games.controls: Tap the correct Roman numeral answer from the choices provided.
walkthrough: Step 1: Read the mathematical equation in Roman numerals.
Step 2: Convert the numerals into standard numbers in your head.
Step 3: Perform the addition, subtraction, or multiplication.
Step 4: Convert the result back to Roman numerals and select it.
strategies: Memorize key values: I=1, V=5, X=10, L=50, C=100.
Watch out for subtractive notation (e.g., IV = 4, IX = 9).
Do the math in base-10 first to avoid errors.

games.title: Sequence Sleuth
games.subtitle: Find the missing number in the mathematical sequence.
games.objective: Identify the underlying pattern in a sequence of numbers or symbols and determine the missing element.
games.controls: Tap or enter the correct missing element to complete the sequence.
walkthrough: Step 1: Examine the provided sequence of items.
Step 2: Determine the rule governing the progression (e.g., +2, x3, alternating shapes).
Step 3: Calculate the missing value based on this rule.
Step 4: Input the correct answer to solve the puzzle.
strategies: Check the differences between adjacent numbers first.
If simple addition doesn't work, try multiplication or alternating patterns.
Verify your hypothesized rule against all given parts of the sequence.

games.title: Sum Pyramid
games.subtitle: Fill the pyramid so each brick equals the two below.
games.objective: Fill in the empty blocks of the pyramid such that every block's number is the exact sum of the two blocks directly beneath it.
games.controls: Tap an empty block in the pyramid to select it, then use the number pad to enter the correct value. Tap the backspace button to clear a mistake.
walkthrough: Step 1: Look for an empty block that has both blocks beneath it filled, or a filled block with one empty block beneath it.
Step 2: Tap the empty block to select it.
Step 3: Calculate the sum or difference and enter the number using the keypad.
Step 4: Submit your answer to check if the pyramid is correctly solved.
strategies: Work from the bottom up when you have adjacent base numbers.
Work top-down using subtraction when you have a top block and one of its base blocks.

games.title: Sum Snake
games.subtitle: Connect adjacent numbers to reach the target sum.
games.objective: Trace a continuous, non-overlapping path through the grid of numbers so that the sum of the numbers on the path exactly equals the target value.
games.controls: Tap and drag across adjacent grid cells (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally) to draw your path. Release to submit.
walkthrough: Step 1: Note the target sum required at the top of the screen.
Step 2: Find a starting number on the grid.
Step 3: Drag your finger across adjacent numbers, keeping track of the running sum.
Step 4: Release your finger once the sum of the highlighted path matches the target exactly.
strategies: If the target is large, look for paths containing high numbers.
If you overshoot the target, retrace your path backwards to deselect cells.

games.title: Target 10
games.subtitle: Select a combination of number tiles from the 5x5 grid whose sum equals exactly 10.
games.objective: Select a combination of number tiles from the 5x5 grid whose sum equals exactly 10.
games.controls: Tap the tiles on the grid to select or deselect them and add their values to your current selection sum.
walkthrough: Step 1: Look at the numbers available on the 5x5 grid.
Step 2: Tap a number to start your selection.
Step 3: Tap additional numbers, keeping an eye on the Selection Sum indicator.
Step 4: Select a combination that adds up to exactly 10 to clear those tiles and score points.
strategies: Look for obvious pairs that make 10, like 9+1 or 8+2.
You can use three or more numbers (e.g., 5+3+2) if simple pairs are not available.

games.title: Unit Converter
games.subtitle: Answer quick unit conversions under time limits.
games.objective: Convert values between different units of measurement (e.g. Celsius to Fahrenheit, meters to feet).
games.controls: Enter the converted value on the number pad and submit.
walkthrough: Step 1: Note the starting value, its unit, and the target unit of measurement.
Step 2: Calculate the converted value using the appropriate conversion multiplier or formula.
Step 3: Input the calculated target value on the numpad.
Step 4: Submit to verify your answer.
strategies: Memorize basic conversion benchmarks (e.g. 1 inch = 2.54 cm, 0°C = 32°F).
Estimate calculations if exact values are complex.
Pay attention to units to avoid division vs multiplication swaps.

games.title: Venn Numbers
games.subtitle: Categorize numbers into the correct Venn diagram regions.
games.objective: Place numbers into the correct intersections of a Venn diagram according to numerical properties.
games.controls: Drag and drop the number tokens into the Venn diagram sections.
walkthrough: Step 1: Read the property tags for each circle (e.g. 'Prime', 'Even', 'Multiple of 3').
Step 2: Analyze the properties of the given number token.
Step 3: Drag the number into the intersection where it satisfies all matching circle properties.
Step 4: Place all numbers correctly to win.
strategies: Check if the number fits none of the categories and belongs on the outer boundary.
Take your time validating overlapping circle criteria.
Find numbers that fit the central intersection of all circles first.

games.title: Venn Sets
games.subtitle: Shade the Venn regions matching the set formula.
games.objective: Select the correct regions of the Venn diagram matching the given set theory formula.
games.controls: Tap regions of the Venn diagram or the outside space to select them, then tap SUBMIT.
walkthrough: Step 1: Read the set expression (e.g., A ∩ B, A ∪ B, A \ B, (A ∪ B)').
Step 2: Identify whether the formula targets only A, only B, the intersection, or the outer universe.
Step 3: Toggle the appropriate region cards and submit your answer.
strategies: Intersection (∩) means only the overlapping region.
Union (∪) combines all interior parts of both sets.
Complement (') refers to everything outside the specified set.

games.title: Sequence
games.subtitle: Watch the pattern and tap it back in order.
games.objective: MEMORY
games.controls: Tap the colored buttons in the correct order.
walkthrough: Step 1: Watch the buttons flash in a specific sequence.
Step 2: Wait for the sequence to finish playing.
Step 3: Repeat the sequence by tapping the buttons in the exact same order.
Step 4: With each round, a new step is added to the sequence.
strategies: Use both visual and auditory memory; hum the tune while visualizing the colors.
Assign numbers or words to the colors and repeat them in your head.
Group the sequence into chunks of 3 or 4 to make it easier to remember.

games.title: 3D Maze Navigation
games.subtitle: Navigate through a 3D maze to find the exit from a first-person perspective.
games.objective: Navigate through a 3D maze to find the exit from a first-person perspective.
games.controls: Use the on-screen directional buttons or swipe to move forward, backward, and turn.
walkthrough: Step 1: Look around to orient yourself in the 3D environment.
Step 2: Move forward through the corridors.
Step 3: Memorize intersections to avoid walking in circles.
Step 4: Find the exit door or portal to win.
strategies: Use the 'right-hand rule': always keep your right hand on the wall to eventually find the exit.
Look out for unique textures or landmarks to remember where you've been.

games.title: Block Count 3D
games.subtitle: Determine the total number of individual cubes that make up a complex 3D block structure.
games.objective: Determine the total number of individual cubes that make up a complex 3D block structure.
games.controls: Drag your finger across the 3D viewport to rotate the structure. Use the virtual numpad to enter your count and tap submit.
walkthrough: Step 1: Examine the 3D block structure displayed on the screen.
Step 2: Drag to rotate the model and view it from different angles to ensure you don'''t miss hidden blocks.
Step 3: Count the blocks, remembering that any block on a higher tier must be supported by blocks beneath it.
Step 4: Type the total number of blocks using the virtual numpad.
Step 5: Tap the submit button to check your answer.
strategies: Count column by column. A column that is 3 blocks high contributes 3 to your total.
Rotate the view to look straight down from the top to easily count the base footprint.
Ensure you account for blocks completely hidden in the center of a larger structure.

games.title: Block Stacking
games.subtitle: Stack irregular block panels balancing gravity weight.
games.objective: Stack moving blocks on top of each other as high as possible by timing your drops perfectly.
games.controls: Tap anywhere on the screen to drop the currently moving active block.
walkthrough: Step 1: Watch the active block slide back and forth across the top of the stack.
Step 2: Time your tap so the active block aligns perfectly with the block below it.
Step 3: When you tap, the block drops. Any overhanging portion is sliced off, making your next block smaller.
Step 4: Continue stacking until you reach the target height to win.
Step 5: If you miss the stack entirely, the tower falls and the game is over.
strategies: Focus your eyes on the edges of the stationary block below, and tap exactly when the moving block's edge aligns with it.
As the blocks get smaller, the game gets harder; prioritize perfect alignment early on.
Get into a rhythm, as the block speed increases slightly with each successful drop.

games.title: Classic Maze
games.subtitle: Guide the marker from start to the exit.
games.objective: Navigate from the starting position to the goal through a complex maze.
games.controls: Swipe in the direction you want to move the character, or use directional buttons.
walkthrough: Step 1: Locate your starting point and the end goal.
Step 2: Swipe up, down, left, or right to move.
Step 3: Find the open path without hitting dead ends.
Step 4: Reach the goal to complete the maze.
strategies: Trace the path backwards from the goal with your eyes before moving.
Look ahead at intersections to avoid long dead ends.
Move efficiently to complete the maze in fewer moves or less time.

games.title: Compass Maze
games.subtitle: Reach the exit as each step rotates your compass.
games.objective: Navigate a grid where you can only move in the directions indicated by the current tile's compass.
games.controls: Tap an adjacent tile in a valid direction to move.
walkthrough: Step 1: Look at the compass arrows on your current tile.
Step 2: Move to an adjacent tile that aligns with one of those arrows.
Step 3: Repeat to find a path to the goal.
Step 4: Reach the goal tile to win.
strategies: Work backwards from the goal to see which tiles point to it.
Avoid tiles with arrows that point to dead ends or boundaries.
Look for loops and avoid getting trapped.

games.title: Cross-Section Slice
games.subtitle: Pick the 2D slice cut through the 3D solid.
games.objective: The objective is to correctly identify the 2D shape that results from slicing a 3D solid with a plane.
games.controls: Tap the button corresponding to the correct 2D shape at the bottom of the screen.
walkthrough: Step 1: Observe the 3D solid and the highlighted plane slicing through it in the main view area.
Step 2: Mentally visualize the 2D cross-section shape created exactly where the plane intersects the solid.
Step 3: Look at the 2D shape options at the bottom of the screen.
Step 4: Tap the option that matches your visualized shape. Correctly identify the target number of cross-sections to win.
strategies: Pay close attention to the angle of the slicing plane; a diagonal cut through a cylinder makes an ellipse, not a circle.
Imagine looking directly 'down' the slicing plane perpendicular to its surface to 'see' the true 2D shape.

games.title: Cube Net Fold
games.subtitle: Pick the 3D cube that folds from the flat net.
games.objective: Identify which 3D cube configuration matches the unfolded 2D net shown.
games.controls: Tap on the correct 3D cube option (A, B, or C) at the bottom of the screen, then tap SUBMIT CHOICE.
walkthrough: Step 1: Observe the colors on the unfolded 2D cross-shaped net.
Step 2: Visualize how the net folds into a 3D cube.
Step 3: Examine the three 3D cube options provided.
Step 4: Select the cube that represents a valid rotation of the folded net and submit your choice.
strategies: Look for opposite faces on the net (they will have one square between them) - they can never touch on the folded cube.
Track the relative orientation of three adjacent faces.
Eliminate options that show impossible color combinations.

games.title: Gear Rotation
games.subtitle: Predict the rotation direction of the last gear.
games.objective: Determine the rotation direction of the final gear in a sequence, given the starting gear's direction.
games.controls: Tap the 'CLOCKWISE' or 'COUNTER-CLOCKWISE' button.
walkthrough: Step 1: Observe the chain of interconnected gears.
Step 2: Note the rotation direction of the first gear (indicated by an arrow).
Step 3: Trace the rotation through the chain, remembering that adjacent gears rotate in opposite directions.
Step 4: Select the correct rotation direction for the final gear.
strategies: Adjacent gears always rotate in opposite directions.
If there is an odd number of gears in the chain, the first and last gears rotate in the same direction.
If there is an even number of gears, the first and last gears rotate in opposite directions.

games.title: Hue Sort
games.subtitle: Swap tiles into a smooth gradient; dots stay fixed.
games.objective: Rearrange the color tiles to form a perfect, seamless gradient, using the fixed tiles as anchors.
games.controls: Tap one tile to select it, then tap another tile to swap their positions.
walkthrough: Step 1: Identify the fixed tiles marked with a small dot; these cannot be moved.
Step 2: Look at the color difference between the fixed tiles to understand the direction of the gradient.
Step 3: Tap a movable tile, then tap another to swap them into the correct gradient order.
Step 4: Continue swapping until the colors transition smoothly across the entire grid.
strategies: Start by organizing the edges or corners connecting the fixed tiles.
Sort by one color dimension at a time (e.g., getting all the darkest tiles to one side).
If a tile looks slightly 'off', swap it with an immediate neighbor to see if the transition improves.

games.title: Interlock Puzzle
games.subtitle: Free the interlocking blocks in the right order.
games.objective: Determine if two 3D block shapes will fit together perfectly to form a solid cube/prism.
games.controls: Drag on the screen to rotate the 3D shapes. Tap 'YES' or 'NO' to submit your answer.
walkthrough: Step 1: Examine 'Shape A' and 'Shape B'.
Step 2: Drag your finger across the screen to rotate both shapes and view them from all angles.
Step 3: Mentally rotate one shape and try to slide it into the empty spaces of the other.
Step 4: Tap 'YES' if they interlock perfectly, or 'NO' if they do not.
strategies: Count the number of blocks in both shapes; their sum must equal the total volume of the target solid.
Look for prominent protrusions on one shape and find the corresponding indentations on the other.
Rotate the shapes to align their axes mentally, making it easier to visualize the fit.

games.title: Klotski Escape
games.subtitle: Slide blocks to guide the main piece to the exit.
games.objective: Move the 2x2 HERO block to the escape zone at the bottom middle of the board by sliding blocks out of the way.
games.controls: Tap a block to select it, then tap the directional arrows that appear on it, or swipe the block to move it into an empty space.
walkthrough: Step 1: Identify the 2x2 HERO block.
Step 2: Move the smaller blocks around to clear a path downward.
Step 3: Continue sliding blocks into empty spaces without overlapping.
Step 4: Reach the green escape zone at the bottom middle with the HERO block to win.
strategies: Focus on moving the smaller 1x1 blocks into empty spaces to free up larger ones.
Try to keep the empty spaces together to allow the large 2x2 block to move.

games.title: Laser Link
games.subtitle: Turn mirrors so the laser lights every target.
games.objective: Place mirrors to reflect the laser from the source so that it hits all the target positions.
games.controls: Tap on empty cells in the grid to cycle through mirror types (forward slash '/' or backslash '\').
walkthrough: Step 1: Observe the laser source position and its initial direction.
Step 2: Note the target positions the laser must reach.
Step 3: Tap grid cells to place mirrors and reflect the laser path.
Step 4: Ensure the laser hits all targets to complete the level.
strategies: Trace the laser path backward from the targets to figure out where mirrors are needed.
Experiment with both mirror types to find the correct reflection angles.

games.title: Mental Mapping
games.subtitle: Follow the directions and find the destination.
games.objective: Follow a series of directional instructions mentally and identify the final location on a map.
games.controls: Tap the final destination cell on the grid.
walkthrough: Step 1: Note your starting position on the grid.
Step 2: Read or listen to the sequence of directional movements (e.g., North, East).
Step 3: Track the movements mentally without touching the screen.
Step 4: Tap the final cell where the path ends.
strategies: Cancel out opposing moves in your head (e.g., Up then Down means you didn't move).
Keep your eyes fixed on the starting point and move your focus exactly as instructed.

games.title: Mental Rotation
games.subtitle: Are these shapes the same, just rotated?
games.objective: Determine if two 3D shapes are identical but rotated, or mirror images.
games.controls: Tap 'Match' or 'Different' based on your spatial visualization.
walkthrough: Step 1: Look at the primary 3D block structure.
Step 2: Look at the second 3D block structure.
Step 3: Mentally rotate the first structure to align with the second.
Step 4: Decide if they are the exact same shape or a mirrored version.
strategies: Focus on a single distinctive feature or 'arm' of the shape and track its rotation.
Try to identify the handedness (left/right) of asymmetric parts.

games.title: Mirror Image
games.subtitle: Identify the correct mirror reflection.
games.objective: Identify the exact mirror reflection of the presented shape or image.
games.controls: Tap the correct reflection from the list of multiple-choice options.
walkthrough: Step 1: Carefully observe the target image presented at the start.
Step 2: Examine the multiple-choice options presented.
Step 3: Mentally mirror the target image along the specified axis.
Step 4: Tap the option that matches your mental reflection to advance.
strategies: Focus on asymmetrical details like protrusions or colors.
Pick one specific point on the target and find where it should end up after the flip.
Eliminate clearly incorrect options first to improve your odds.

games.title: Mirror Maze
games.subtitle: Redirect a laser beam using diagonal mirrors.
games.objective: Turn a beam with mirrors so it leaves the board at the receiver, heading the way the receiver points.
games.controls: Tap a cell to cycle it through empty, /, \ and back to empty. A mirror turns the beam 90 degrees.
walkthrough: Step 1: The arrow at the edge is the beam: it enters that cell and travels the way the arrow points.
Step 2: The receiver is the exit. The beam has to leave the board from that cell, in the direction it points.
Step 3: Start at the receiver and work backwards: one mirror has to be placed so the beam leaves right there.
Step 4: Tap a cell to put a mirror on the beam path, tap again to swap its angle.
Step 5: Two mirrors win every board here. A single mirror never does.
strategies: Every mirror bends the beam by 90 degrees, so count the turns between the arrow and the receiver before you tap.
The two angles bend the beam in opposite directions: if one sends it off the wrong edge, try the other angle on that cell.
A beam that leaves the board at the wrong edge means the first mirror sits on the wrong cell, not that the angle is wrong.

games.title: Mirror Tracing
games.subtitle: Trace the star! Controls are MIRRORED.
games.objective: Trace a given shape as accurately as possible while your input is mirrored.
games.controls: Drag your finger across the screen to draw; your strokes will appear mirrored.
walkthrough: Step 1: Look at the dotted outline of the shape you need to trace.
Step 2: Place your finger on the starting point.
Step 3: Drag your finger to trace the shape, adjusting for the inverted movement.
Step 4: Complete the full outline with minimal deviation to achieve a high score.
strategies: Move slowly and deliberately, especially around corners.
Focus your eyes on the drawing tip rather than your finger.
Anticipate the opposite direction before making a move.

games.title: Negative Space
games.subtitle: Spot the figure hidden in the empty space.
games.objective: Identify the hidden shape or letter formed by the negative space between objects.
games.controls: Tap the correct answer from the options, or type the identified shape.
walkthrough: Step 1: Look at the complex image presented on the screen.
Step 2: Shift your focus from the solid objects to the empty background spaces.
Step 3: Identify the cohesive shape formed by that empty space.
Step 4: Select or input the correct answer.
strategies: Try squinting or relaxing your eyes to blur the foreground.
Look at the edges of the solid objects; they form the outline of the negative shape.
Mentally invert the colors (imagine the background is black and objects are white).

games.title: Paper Folding
games.subtitle: What will it look like when unfolded?
games.objective: Determine the final pattern of holes after a folded piece of paper is punched and unfolded.
games.controls: Tap on the correct result grid out of the 4 options provided.
walkthrough: Step 1: Observe the folding sequence indicated by the arrows.
Step 2: Note where the hole punch is made on the folded paper.
Step 3: Mentally unfold the paper in reverse order.
Step 4: Select the option that matches your visualized hole pattern.
strategies: Track the reflections of the punch across each fold line.
Eliminate options that have holes in impossible locations.
Remember that diagonal folds swap the X and Y coordinates.

games.title: Path Intersect
games.subtitle: Route every path to its goal without crossing.
games.objective: Identify the exact grid coordinate where two overlapping colored paths intersect.
games.controls: Tap the specific cell on the grid where the paths cross.
walkthrough: Step 1: Observe the two different colored paths drawn on the screen.
Step 2: Follow the trajectories of both paths visually.
Step 3: Locate the single cell where they overlap.
Step 4: Tap the intersection cell to verify your answer.
strategies: Focus on the general region where horizontal and vertical segments meet.
Trace one path with your eyes and look for the color break of the other.
Don't rush; confirm the grid square aligns with both path lines.

games.title: Perspective Shift
games.subtitle: Rotate block clusters until they spell letters/words.
games.objective: Identify how a 3D block structure looks when viewed from a different specific angle.
games.controls: Tap the 2D projection that matches the requested viewing angle.
walkthrough: Step 1: Examine the 3D block structure shown in the center.
Step 2: Note the requested viewing direction (e.g., Top, Left, Front).
Step 3: Mentally rotate the object to face that direction.
Step 4: Select the corresponding 2D silhouette from the options.
strategies: Count the maximum height or width of blocks to rule out incorrect options.
Look for distinct features like gaps or protruding blocks.
Visualize standing on the side of the object being requested.

games.title: Perspective Taking
games.subtitle: Which view is from the ?
games.objective: Determine the left/right orientation or spatial layout from the viewpoint of an avatar in the scene.
games.controls: Select the correct direction or object layout based on the avatar's perspective.
walkthrough: Step 1: Observe the avatar's position and the direction they are facing.
Step 2: Note the target object in relation to the avatar.
Step 3: Mentally step into the avatar's shoes to determine left or right.
Step 4: Tap the correct answer option.
strategies: If the avatar is facing you, their left and right are opposite to yours.
Use physical cues like turning your body or head slightly to help visualize.
Focus on the avatar's hands or orientation markers.

games.title: Polyomino
games.subtitle: Pack the shapes into the grid with no gaps.
games.objective: Arrange and rotate tetromino pieces to tile the 4x4 board completely without overlaps.
games.controls: Tap a piece to select, tap ROTATE, then tap a grid cell to place.
walkthrough: Step 1: Select a piece from the tray.
Step 2: Rotate if necessary to fit the empty board space.
Step 3: Tap the board square to place it.
strategies: Place awkward pieces (like L and J shapes) first.
Leave square-friendly holes for the O piece.

games.title: Rotating Maze
games.subtitle: Turn the maze so gravity rolls the ball out.
games.objective: Navigate a ball through a maze to the exit by rotating the entire maze structure.
games.controls: Tap the left or right rotation buttons (or drag) to tilt the maze.
walkthrough: Step 1: Observe the ball's current position and the location of the exit.
Step 2: Plan a path through the corridors.
Step 3: Rotate the maze so gravity pulls the ball along your planned route.
Step 4: Catch the ball on walls to prevent it falling into traps or dead ends.
strategies: Think one step ahead about where the ball will land after rotation.
Use small, controlled rotations rather than spinning wildly.
Use corners to stall the ball while you reorient the maze.

games.title: Shadow Pivot
games.subtitle: Pick the shadow cast after the 3D shape rotates.
games.objective: Identify the correct 3D object or orientation based on its projected 2D shadow.
games.controls: Swipe to rotate the object or tap to select the matching shadow.
walkthrough: Step 1: Observe the 2D shadow cast on the wall.
Step 2: Examine the 3D objects available.
Step 3: Visualize how each object would cast a shadow from different angles.
Step 4: Select the object that matches the shadow perfectly.
strategies: Focus on distinct edges and asymmetric features of the shadow.
Mentally rotate the objects on the X, Y, and Z axes.
Eliminate options that have features completely missing in the shadow.

games.title: Silhouette Match
games.subtitle: Which silhouette matches this object?
games.objective: Find the exact silhouette that matches the detailed image.
games.controls: Tap the correct silhouette from the available options.
walkthrough: Step 1: Observe the detailed reference image carefully.
Step 2: Look at the provided silhouette options.
Step 3: Notice subtle differences in posture, edges, or negative space.
Step 4: Select the silhouette that is an exact outline of the reference.
strategies: Focus on the edges and negative spaces rather than the center.
Look for small, distinctive features like a raised finger, hair strand, or uneven edge.
Eliminate silhouettes that clearly lack a prominent feature of the original.

games.title: Slide Puzzle
games.subtitle: Slide tiles into order using the empty space.
games.objective: Rearrange the scrambled tiles to form the complete picture or numerical order.
games.controls: Tap or swipe a tile adjacent to the empty space to slide it.
walkthrough: Step 1: Examine the scrambled grid and locate the single empty space.
Step 2: Slide tiles into the empty space to move them around.
Step 3: Try to solve the puzzle row by row, starting from the top.
Step 4: Position the final pieces in the bottom right corner to complete the puzzle.
strategies: Solve the top row and left column first to reduce the puzzle size.
To swap two adjacent pieces, you must rotate them in a loop with the empty space.
Plan your moves ahead to avoid messing up already solved sections.

games.title: Symmetry
games.subtitle: Mirror the left pattern onto the right grid.
games.objective: Complete the symmetrical pattern by toggling cells on the right half of the grid so that it perfectly mirrors the pre-filled left half.
games.controls: Tap or drag across the empty cells on the right side of the grid to toggle them on or off to match the reflection.
walkthrough: Step 1: Observe the pattern of filled cells on the left side of the grid.
Step 2: Imagine a vertical mirror line down the center of the grid.
Step 3: Tap the cells on the right side to fill them in the mirrored positions.
Step 4: Ensure the right side is an exact reflection of the left side to complete the puzzle.
strategies: Work column by column, starting from the center mirror line and moving outwards.
Count the empty spaces from the center line to accurately place mirrored cells.

games.title: Tangram Puzzle
games.subtitle: Arrange the shapes to fill the target silhouette.
games.objective: Completely fill the target outline on the grid by placing and rotating all the provided tangram pieces without any overlap.
games.controls: Tap a piece in the dock to select it, double-tap to rotate it, and tap a cell on the grid to place the piece's pivot point.
walkthrough: Step 1: Observe the target outline on the main grid.
Step 2: Tap a piece in the dock to select it.
Step 3: Double-tap the piece if you need to rotate it to fit.
Step 4: Tap on the grid to place the piece, and repeat until the target shape is perfectly filled.
strategies: Start by placing the largest pieces or those with unique shapes that only fit in specific corners.
If you get stuck, remove pieces and try a different rotation for the first piece.

games.title: Topology
games.subtitle: Decide whether one shape stretches into the other.
games.objective: Determine if two displayed characters or shapes are topologically equivalent, meaning one can be stretched or deformed into the other without tearing or merging holes.
games.controls: Tap the YES button if they are topologically equivalent, or the NO button if they are not.
walkthrough: Step 1: Look at the two shapes or characters presented on the screen.
Step 2: Count the number of holes (closed loops) in each shape.
Step 3: Consider the number of endpoints or intersections.
Step 4: Tap YES if they have the same topological properties, or NO if they differ.
strategies: The most important feature is the number of holes; an 'O' and a 'D' are equivalent (1 hole), but an 'O' and an '8' are not (1 vs 2 holes).
Imagine the shape is made of rubber and see if you can bend one into the other.

games.title: Trace Path
games.subtitle: Follow the target path as closely as you can
games.objective: Carefully trace the drawn path from the start point to the end point, staying as close to the line as possible to achieve high accuracy.
games.controls: Tap and hold on the starting marker, then drag your finger along the path to the ending marker.
walkthrough: Step 1: Locate the starting marker of the target path.
Step 2: Press and hold your finger on the start marker.
Step 3: Drag your finger along the curve of the path, trying to stay exactly on the line.
Step 4: Release your finger when you reach the end marker to get your accuracy score.
strategies: Move at a steady, moderate pace; moving too fast reduces accuracy, but moving too slow makes it hard to draw smooth curves.
Look slightly ahead of your finger to anticipate the curves.

games.title: Affix Factory
games.subtitle: Create valid words using prefixes and suffixes
games.objective: Select the correct prefix or suffix that attaches to a given base word to form a new valid word.
games.controls: Tap the correct affix button from the multiple-choice options provided.
walkthrough: Step 1: Read the base word displayed in the center of the screen.
Step 2: Look at the multiple-choice affix options (e.g., 'un-', '-ly', 're-').
Step 3: Determine which affix can be legally attached to the base word.

Short, basic everyday words often come from Old English/Germanic roots.
Scientific or abstract concepts frequently have Latin or Greek origins.

games.title: Find Word

Search the grid systematically starting from the top-left.
Verify the direction of the word (forward, backward, diagonal) before dragging.

games.title: Grammar Police

games.title: Homophone Hunt

games.title: Letter Bridge

games.title: Letter Swapper

games.title: Missing Vowels

Look for common prefixes and suffixes that might hint at the vowels.
If stuck, try plugging in 'E' or 'A' first, as they are the most common.

games.title: One-Letter Shift

Don't worry if your path isn't the shortest, as long as every step is a real word.

games.title: Oxymoron Hunt

Familiarize yourself with common oxymorons like 'jumbo shrimp' or 'awfully good'.

Work from the outside in, placing common prefixes and their mirrored suffixes.
Ensure the resulting string actually spells a real word in the dictionary.

games.title: Pangram Sprint

Remember classic pangrams like 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog'.

games.title: Word Wheel
games.subtitle: Build words of 3+ letters using the centre letter.
games.objective: The objective is to find valid words using the provided letters, where each word must include the central letter.
games.controls: Tap the letter buttons to spell a word, use the backspace button to correct mistakes, and tap the SUBMIT button to enter your guess.
walkthrough: Step 1: Look at the letter wheel, paying special attention to the central letter.
Step 2: Spell out a word using the provided letters (minimum 3 letters) by tapping the letter buttons. The word MUST contain the central letter.
Step 3: Tap SUBMIT to check your word. If it's valid, it will be added to your found words list.
Step 4: Find the required target number of words to win the game.
strategies: Try finding prefixes and suffixes you can make with the outer letters to attach to the central letter.
Look for the 'Pangram' - a word that uses all 7 letters provided in the wheel.
